sn48.42:1.2: atha kho uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn48.42:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn48.42:2.1: “pañcimāni bho gotama, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni na aññamaññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti.
sn48.42:2.4: imesaṃ nu kho bho gotama, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ nānāvisayānaṃ nānāgocarānaṃ na aññamaññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhontānaṃ kiṃ paṭisaraṇaṃ ko ca nesaṃ gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhotīti.
sn48.42:3.1: pañcimāni brāhmaṇa, indriyāni nānāvisayāni nānāgocarāni na aññamaññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhonti.
sn48.42:3.4: imesaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ nānāvisayānaṃ nānāgocarānaṃ na aññamaññassa gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhontānaṃ mano paṭisaraṇaṃ. manova tesaṃ gocaravisayaṃ paccanubhotīti.
sn48.42:4.1: manassa pana bho gotama kiṃ paṭisaraṇanti?
sn48.42:4.3: satiyā pana bho gotama, kiṃ paṭisaraṇanti?
sn48.42:4.5: vimuttiyā pana bho gotama kiṃ paṭisaraṇanti?
sn48.42:4.7: nibbānassa pana bho gotama, kiṃ paṭisaraṇanti?
sn48.42:4.8: accasarā brāhmaṇa, pañhaṃ. nāsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ.
sn48.42:4.9: nibbānogadhaṃ hi brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyaṃ vussati nibbānaparāyaṇaṃ nibbānapariyosānanti.
sn48.42:5.1: atha kho uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkami.
sn48.42:6.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkante uṇṇābhe brāhmaṇe bhikkhū āmantesi;
sn48.42:6.2: “seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kūṭāgāre vā kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ vā pācīnavātapānā sūriye uggacchante vātapānena rasmi pavisitvā kvāssa patiṭṭhitāti.
sn48.42:6.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, uṇṇābhassa brāhmaṇassa tathāgate saddhā niviṭṭhā mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā daḷhā asaṃhāriyā samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.
sn48.42:6.5: imamhi ce bhikkhave, samaye uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo kālaṃ kareyya, natthi taṃ saṃyojanaṃ yena saṃyojanena saṃyutto uṇṇābho brāhmaṇo puna imaṃ lokaṃ āgaccheyyāti.
